data.description:
## Context / Problem
A top-level command cannot truthfully declare one required package extra. Optionality varies by nested mode, workflow contents, analyzer, renderer, or selected provider. Enforcing extras during route discovery would hide stable verbs and break lean diagnostic paths; converting every missing dependency to an error would regress intentional unavailable, abstain, and fallback behavior.

## Approach
Create a stdlib-only semantic capability registry independent of the command registry. Each immutable record names a semantic key, packaging extra, and missing posture. The initial complete runtime census is:

- `agent_runtime → agents/error`, `audit_ui → ui/error`, `bedrock_provider → bedrock/error`, `jira_datacenter → jira-datacenter/error`, and `s3_remote → s3/error`;
- `metrics_lizard → metrics/unavailable` and `pricing → pricing/unavailable`;
- `grounding_structural → grounding/abstain` and `grounding_t2 → grounding-t2/abstain`;
- `cloud_adf → adf/fallback`, `datacenter_wiki → wiki/fallback`, and `trace_export → tracing/fallback`;
- separate-entrypoint `mcp_server → mcp/error` and `review_bot → reviewbot/error`, reusable without adding CLI verbs.

`dev` is packaging/development metadata and is not a runtime capability. Validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's possible capability name exists, and no probe imports the optional package.

Expose a narrow shared error helper for `error` capabilities. Invoke it only after existing handlers/factories parse the selected mode/backend: `audit show` before `audit serve`; status/check/dry-run paths before live agent work; provider selection before Bedrock/Jira DC/S3 client construction. For `unavailable`, `abstain`, and `fallback`, domain components retain control of result payloads and logging; they may consult registry metadata/install hints but the registry never manufactures their domain result.

## Compatibility and Rollback
Preserve existing exact install guidance, exit/error types, and degraded output shapes. Stable verbs and top-level help never depend on installed extras. Existing `_optional.require_extra` and `guard_import` remain compatibility surfaces during expansion and delegate to the new semantic seam where applicable. Rollback restores those direct calls; no persisted data changes.

## Testing
Use unit tests for capability validation and shared error text. Use clean no-extras subprocess/production-path tests for each posture and contrast mode: lean `audit show` versus selected `audit serve`; review/workflow diagnostics versus live agent construction; unselected versus selected Bedrock/Jira DC/S3; metrics/pricing unavailable; grounding abstain; ADF/wiki/tracing fallback. Block heavy modules in `sys.modules` and import hooks during registry/help construction. Separate `rebar-mcp` and review-bot entrypoint smoke tests assert their packaging capabilities without adding CLI routes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every initial semantic capability above validates against one declared packaging extra and one typed missing posture without importing its probe module.
- [ ] Stable commands and top-level help remain present in a no-extras wheel; only the selected capability boundary emits an actionable error for `error` postures.
- [ ] Lean diagnostic/read/dry-run modes execute without requiring sibling live capabilities, including `audit show` and non-agent review/workflow paths.
- [ ] Metrics/pricing unavailable, grounding abstain, ADF/wiki/tracing fallback, and selected provider errors retain their existing domain output, exception, stream, and exit contracts.
- [ ] `rebar-mcp` and review-bot remain separate entry points and can consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level route registry.
data.title: RP-05 S4 — Enforce semantic capabilities at selected execution boundaries
